title.narrative: Somalia Joint Rule of Law Programme

description.narrative:
The Somalia Joint Rule of Law Programme aims at enhancing the capacity of Somalia’s Rule of Law System to cater to the needs of all, and especially vulnerable groups. To achieve this strategic objective, the programme is structured around two interrelated outcomes: 

1. Establish independent and accountable justice institutions capable of addressing the justice needs of the people of Somalia by delivering justice for all; 

2. Establish unified, capable, accountable and rights-based Somali Police Force providing safety and order for all the people in Somalia. 

UNOPS handles the work package of construction or refurbishment of justice sector structures in Kismayo, Baidoa and a number of justice sector structures in Mogadishu, as well as the Mogadishu Court and Prison complex. The project funds are channeled through the UN Multi-Partner Trust Fund (UN MPTF).
